assumptions: Metric scale comes from a monocular depth model given the focal length COLMAP estimated from the same frames; nothing in this tier measured a distance directly

Camera-height prior: the phone was held at 1.40 m plus or minus 0.12 m, and each chunk is scaled so its own median camera sits that far above its own floor plane. This is the capture protocol, not a measurement, and its uncertainty is carried into every interval

Single-room fitting: the clip covers one room, so the room is the smallest rectilinear shape containing the whole camera path out to the wall faces found on each side. Sides with no face are closed by that assumption, not measured
Manhattan assumption: walls meet at right angles and are axis aligned after a single global rotation. A curved or 45 degree wall appears as a missing face, not a wrong one
Ceiling height prior 2.2 to 3.2 m used where the ceiling was not observed
All rooms are reconstructed in one world frame, so stitching placements are the identity
